overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the September 21 meeting had only two of five Board members plus the Town Manager, so no quorum and no required posted deliberation.

allegations.summary: Complainant, a Board member, alleged he was invited to an unposted private meeting on September 21 under false pretenses, in violation of the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: Because there was no quorum present at this meeting, since a quorum of the Board is three members, there was no deliberation necessitating a posted meeting.
